description: Some vendors sell stock for gold bullion, stamps, tadpole badges or possum badges instead of caps.
x-help:
Pick the currency's section, then add each item the vendors sell and its price in that currency. The price is what the player pays, before any vendor discount; it does not use the item's cap value.

Items without a price in the section are not sold for that currency. Prices must be whole numbers of at least 1.
